limitations: The original 71 events are a historical Mass comparison taxonomy, not 71 native LIVE cards or current source cues.
Assigned macro owners mean source research belongs in that editorial section; they do not certify every rite/form exception, source claim, or exact paragraph trigger.
Only map by explicit old event identification. E01/E02/E71 remain outside the fixed 39-owner Mass body; E46/E55 span multiple prayers.
Old 422 claim-text and original authority fields remain in the immutable archive and are not re-copied here.
St Francis de Sales attribution and historical allegory remain attributed meditation, not normative Roman 1962 actions.
Requiem second Confiteor in E61 remains historical/optional and must not be projected as universal requirement.
